oracleRisk.summary: BD's five immutable branch PriceFeeds consume API3 AggregatorV3-compatible dAPI proxies with a 25-hour validity bound. wstETH and rETH have alternate post-shutdown pricing paths, while WETH, cbBTC, and cbETH freeze onto lastGoodPrice if a required feed fails. All API3 proxies share one Base Api3Server and proxy owner, so the multiple feed legs are not independent provider failure domains.

branchApplicability.rationale: At Base block 50259336 the official CollateralRegistry enumerated five live, positive-debt branches with separate PriceFeed, TroveManager, Stability Pool, and immutable risk-parameter contracts, so every launch branch requires its own oracle and liquidation row.

branches.label: WETH collateral branch
branches.summary: The WETH branch consumes the API3 ETH/USD dAPI through an immutable branch PriceFeed and permanently shuts onto lastGoodPrice when the answer is invalid or more than 25 hours old.

feeds.path: API3 ETH/USD ReaderProxy -> WETHPriceFeed 0x40b4199347af7738643ef4a12a771f7421b84e7f -> Trove collateral ratio

branches.fallbackBehavior: A reverting, non-positive, or more-than-90,000-second-old ETH/USD answer permanently shuts the branch and changes priceSource from primary to lastGoodPrice. There is no alternate live provider; subsequent reads retain the frozen price.

collateralParameters.note: CCR 150%; debt limit 100,000,000 BD; priceSource primary and shutdownTime zero at the observed block. Branch debt was 13,408.616 BD, 26.32% of measured system debt.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Any caller can immediately liquidate a Trove below the 110% MCR. The branch Stability Pool offsets and burns BD debt first; uncovered debt and collateral are redistributed to active WETH Troves in the same branch.
branches.backstop: The branch-local Stability Pool held 3,932.121 BD at the observed block; same-branch redistribution handles liquidated debt not covered by deposits.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Oracle failure or TCR below the 110% SCR permanently stops new borrower operations, freezes interest, and enables urgent redemption. Stability Pool losses and same-branch redistribution remain, but no unconditional recapitalization fund covers residual system bad debt.

The fallback changes calculation but does not remove the common API3 provider domain.
